figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Overview of Structured Flow Autoencoders (SFAs). (a) SFA framework showing co-evolving conditional probabilities for latent z and observed x with conditional CNFs. In the SCFM objective, we compute a convolution of conditional vector field vt for xt (·, zt ) with respect to qt (zt |xt ), when xt = (1 − t)x0 + tx1 . For conditional generation, sampling follows z1 ∼ p1 (z1 ), x1 ∼ p1 (x1 |z1 ); latent representation involves z̃1 ∼ q1 (z1 |x1 ). (b) 1D PCA projected sampled trajectories on MNIST. Top: observation paths given the posterior sample z1 . Bottom: latent paths given observed x1 sampled from different digit classes. The latent trajectories diverge smoothly from shared noise, showing SFA learns structured transport; the likelihood paths conditioned on z1 are cleanly separated by digit classes, confirming the posterior encodes meaningful latent structure.

caption.text: Table 1: Comparing generated samples to data samples with W1 metric (Earth Mover’s Distance). cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 establishes density fidelity plus structured latent representation; Figure 2 enumerates continuous, mixture, and dynamic interfaces; Figure 3 maps Theorem 3.1/SCFM to framework and trajectories; Tables 1–4 and Figure 4 bind main claims; Figures 5–10 add appendix projections, posterior samples, predictive grids, and dynamics.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Numbered Figure/Table captions use Nimbus Roman No9 L around 9.963 pt. Main captions combine title, setup, encoding, and comparison; Figure 3 and Table 1 state findings, while Figures 7, 9, and 10 are terse. Appendix captions often omit sample counts, uncertainty, and axis/color definitions.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Booktabs tables use mathematical metric headers and ↑/↓ direction arrows, with bold displayed best values. Table 2 places OOD values in parentheses; Table 1 has an undefined parenthesized value. No table displays formal interval/error-bar notation.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figures 2–3 explain SFA/SCFM. Table 1 tests Pinwheel density, Table 2 covers MNIST metrics and posterior variants, Table 3 isolates mixtures, Figure 4 visualizes their posterior, and Table 4/Figure 10 test RNA-seq/LDS transfer.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Figure 5 supports Table 4(a); Figure 6 supports Table 2 IID/OOD clustering; Figure 7 supports Tables 2–3 predictive quality; Figures 8–9 expand Figure 4/Table 3; Figure 10 supports Table 4(b).
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Nimbus Roman No9 L and Computer Modern math are stable for PDF text/tables; embedded raster panels use a smaller sans-serif font with variable legibility.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Black/gray structural/table ink is stable, while categorical colorbars recur with changing class counts and independent scales. Grayscale redundancy is strong for diagrams/images and weak for colored scatter/trajectory panels.

most_reusable_patterns: Matched qualitative grids with fixed data geometry and explicit color semantics.
A common PGM triptych for continuous, mixture, and temporal dependencies.
Mechanism-above-trajectory composites that map equations to empirical paths.
Discrete posterior histograms paired with continuous embeddings on identical method canvases.
Side-by-side heterogeneous subtables documenting held-out and unavailable-metric context.
failure_patterns: Color-heavy small multiples depend on per-panel colorbars and are weak in grayscale.
Appendix projections/samples lack repeatability, uncertainty, or shared coordinate scales.
Parenthesized values are not uniformly defined and can resemble uncertainty.
Figure 6 has a panel-reference error; Figure 10 caption order differs from visible rows.
Figure 7 has large whitespace and little sampling/reference metadata.
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: The paper uses matched structural diagrams and sample grids for intuition, booktabs tables for cross-domain decisions, and appendix projections/posterior/dynamics views for latent support; its strength is method alignment and its weakness is dense color encoding without uncertainty and uneven caption keys.
